text:
maya: Quick sync — we need cross-team alignment on the Q3 staggered launch for SmartServe (customer-driven feature). Goal: two-stage rollout (beta -> GA), must clear security gating and infra prewarm. Can folks call out blockers/owners and acceptance criteria?

raj: From eng side we need runtime changes for adaptive batching + KV cache management. ETA ~3w if infra slots are available. What are the product acceptance criteria (latency/correctness)?

lin: I can own kernel/quant profile selection and perf runs. Q: for GA, do we default to batch_size=8 or 16? For low-latency customers we recommend 8. Will need perf runs on A100 + Tr4.

olga: Infra notes: we can support a small beta pool week of 2024-09-18, but GA requires a reserved GPU pool and formal capacity commit. Also need the network egress policy for private deployments clarified (customer asks). Sample infra policy snippet for prewarm config: 
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  prewarm: true
```

sam: Security: we need a threat model + dataflow diagram before GA. HSM/KMS integration testing is mandatory if customer requires HSM-backed keys — that adds ~2w to timeline. Also confirm whether we need a pen-test for beta or only for GA. :warning:

fiona: I'll own the rollout checklist and gating doc. Creating a single working doc for owners: https://go.company/docs/smartserve-rollout (please add owners + blockers). I'll consolidate milestones and ship a release plan.

maya: Owners so far: Raj -> runtime changes, Lin -> perf/quant, Olga -> infra capacity & tickets, Sam -> security gating, Fiona -> rollout checklist. Raj — can you post minimal acceptance tests?

raj: Ack. Minimal acceptance tests (we'll add as runnable checks):
- cold-start p95 <= 450ms (batch=1)
- token p95 <= 50ms under steady-state throughput
- correctness smoke (10 canonical prompts -> golden outputs)
- end-to-end deploy smoke (staging request -> response)
Example smoke command: 
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"smartserve","input":"Hello"}'

lin: I'll run perf matrix Tue/Wed on A100/Tr4 and attach results to the doc. If quantization is needed we'll bench 8-bit and 4-bit profiles.

olga: I'll reserve a staging pool and open infra ticket INF-4832 for GA capacity + prewarm cron. Prewarm command prototype: `prewarm --model smartserve --duration 2h --pool staging`.

sam: Starting security checklist now. Question for product: will any of the guaranteed customers send PII? If yes, we'll default to no-logs mode and require explicit retention policy.

fiona: Noted — Maya, can you confirm PII expectations so Sam can scope the review? I'll add an explicit step in the gating doc for PII sign-off.

maya: Confirmed — initial pilot customer will send tokenized user queries but not raw PII. We still need KMS/HSM validation for their compliance team.

raj: I'll open a perf PR with the smoke tests and a runbook for how to reproduce locally. ETA PR by Thursday EOD.

olga: INF-4832 created to track GA capacity + prewarm (will link in doc). I'll also add a network policy task for private deployments.

sam: I'll draft the threat model + dataflow and upload by Wednesday. If HSM required, I'll schedule a test window with infra.

maya: Great. Action items summary: everyone add owners to https://go.company/docs/smartserve-rollout by EOD Friday; Raj -> perf PR and smoke tests; Lin -> perf matrix Tue/Wed; Olga -> INF-4832 + reserve pool; Sam -> security checklist + threat model; Fiona -> consolidate gating checklist and publish rollout plan. Next sync: Friday 11:00am PT. :calendar: :eyes:

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4832 created by olga (link: https://go.company/tickets/INF-4832)

maya: Thanks all — please flag any blockers in-thread so Fiona can adjust the timeline.
